course.title: Unit 5 The weather and us--Lesson B-【例句】
course.description: Unit 5 The weather and us--Lesson B-【例句】

sentences.content: Oh no! We can't play basketball in the park.
sentences.english: Oh no ! We can't play basketball in the park
sentences.chinese: 糟糕！我们不能在公园里打篮球了。

sentences.content: It's OK. We can go to the library.
sentences.english: It's OK . We can go to the library
sentences.chinese: 没关系。我们可以去图书馆。

sentences.content: Hmm. Let's go and see a film.
sentences.english: Hmm . Let's go and see a film

sentences.content: On sunny days, we can play basketball.
sentences.english: On sunny days , we can play basketball
sentences.chinese: 在晴朗的日子里，我们可以打篮球。

sentences.content: On snowy days, we can make a snowman.
sentences.english: On snowy days , we can make a snowman
sentences.chinese: 在下雪天，我们可以堆雪人。

sentences.content: It's cold and rainy. We can't play football. But we can make cards at home.
sentences.english: It's cold and rainy . We can't play football . But we can make cards at home
sentences.chinese: 天气又冷又下雨。我们不能踢足球了，但可以在家制作卡片。

sentences.content: Hi John, How are you? I'm in a big park in Sydney today. It's hot and sunny here.
sentences.english: Hi John , How are you ? I'm in a big park in Sydney today . It's hot and sunny here
sentences.chinese: 嗨 John，你好吗？我今天在悉尼的一个大公园里。这里天气炎热，阳光明媚。

sentences.content: It's fun to go to the park with my new friends. We play basketball together.
sentences.english: It's fun to go to the park with my new friends . We play basketball together
sentences.chinese: 和我的新朋友们一起去公园很有趣。我们一起打篮球。

sentences.content: Their children swim in the pool.
sentences.english: Their children swim in the pool
sentences.chinese: 他们的孩子们在泳池里游泳。

sentences.content: How about you? Is it cold and windy in Beijing? Can you fly your kite?
sentences.english: How about you ? Is it cold and windy in Beijing ? Can you fly your kite ?
sentences.chinese: 你呢？北京现在是不是又冷风又大？还能放风筝吗？
